officialRosterAndInjuryRules.verifiedValue: 53 players (expandable to 54 or 55 on game week solely via Standard Elevation Addendum)
officialRosterAndInjuryRules.lineupImpact: Caps how many healthy backups a club can carry at OL, CB, and DL without exposing players to waivers.

officialRosterAndInjuryRules.verifiedValue: 48 active players if >=8 primary offensive linemen (C/G/T) are active; drops to 47 maximum if <8 OL are active
officialRosterAndInjuryRules.lineupImpact: Directly penalizes clubs with multiple OL injuries that cannot dress 8 healthy offensive linemen.

officialRosterAndInjuryRules.verifiedValue: 16 players standard; 17 players if 1 player qualifies via International Player Pathway (IPP) Program
officialRosterAndInjuryRules.lineupImpact: Defines the 3rd/4th-string reserve pool available for short-notice injury replacements.

officialRosterAndInjuryRules.verifiedValue: Up to 2 practice-squad elevations per week; maximum 3 regular-season elevations per player per League Year before requiring 53-man signing
officialRosterAndInjuryRules.lineupImpact: Tracking player elevation counts (1/3, 2/3, 3/3) predicts forced roster cuts or street-free-agent 4th-string starts.

officialRosterAndInjuryRules.rule: Official NFL Game Status & Practice Participation Scale
officialRosterAndInjuryRules.verifiedValue: Game Status: Out / Doubtful / Questionable; Practice Status: DNP / Limited / Full
officialRosterAndInjuryRules.lineupImpact: Provides point-in-time probability weights for starter availability prior to 90-minute pre-kickoff inactives.

officialRosterAndInjuryRules.verifiedValue: Touchdown = 6 pts; Field Goal = 3 pts; Safety = 2 pts; Try = 1 pt (kick/safety) or 2 pts (touchdown)
officialRosterAndInjuryRules.lineupImpact: Creates discrete key-number clustering at margins of 3, 7, 6, 10, 4, and 14 points — invalidating naive continuous Gaussian push pricing.
